item.title: Designation of Prosegur Australia Pty Ltd under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026
item.source: Reserve Bank of Australia, central bank media release feed
item.opening: Media release number 2026-31: The RBA has today designated Prosegur Australia Pty Ltd (Prosegur Australia) (ACN 004 247 358) under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026 (the Act).
